fields.Name: T152 - Studio Workbench Section Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the PSStudioResource internal left-nav + @switch section host + section query-param round-trip — a nested navigation shell unique to the two workbench doors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Predictive Studio app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (scroll the list if needed), then open the 'Studio' nav item (the analyst workbench door). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. The Studio door has its OWN internal left-nav grouped by Overview / Build / Run. Click through several sections — e.g. 'Training Pipelines', then 'Algorithm Catalog', then 'Experiments', then 'Compare Runs' — and verify the main content area swaps to a different panel each time (the header subtitle and body change). Success is the internal section nav switching panels; each panel may show real content or its own empty state.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Studio door renders with an internal left-nav listing sections under Overview / Build / Run groups
Clicking different section items swaps the main panel content (distinct panels for pipelines, catalog, experiments, compare)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
